_why: Hand-checked names for funds whose public name is unusable. Yahoo's longName is Morningstar-sourced and is normally the closest free match to the official share-class name, so it is passed through untouched -- but it is occasionally broken outright, and a name nobody can match to a factsheet is worse than no name. Every entry here must record where the correct name came from and when it was checked. Nothing is 'tidied': an abbreviation Morningstar chose is left alone, because rewriting it would make the name less accurate, not more.
